item.title: CVE-2026-7273 — Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.
